scientific_integrity: Infinite assertions are proved by a facet-and-integral-semigroup argument; finite exact checks are corroborative only. No independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the reduced singular support and generic transverse germs of the named positive-dimensional components are classified. The nonreduced singular scheme and local germs at pairwise component intersections are not determined. An equivalent unpublished or differently indexed prior statement remains possible. Assumes r,s>=3.
title: Singular components and transverse determinantal models of one-circuit-hyperplane matroid toric varieties
